regulationRef.description: ESPR 32024R1781 mandates no product data of its own. Art. 7(1) makes information requirements those 'laid down in the delegated acts adopted pursuant to Article 4'; Art. 9(2) says those acts 'shall … specify' what a passport carries; and Art. 27 binds manufacturers only 'when placing products COVERED BY a delegated act adopted pursuant to Article 4' on the market. Art. 7(1) makes information requirements those 'laid down in the delegated acts adopted pursuant to Article 4'; Art. 9(2) says those acts 'shall … specify' what a passport carries; and Art. 27 binds manufacturers only 'when placing products COVERED BY a delegated act adopted pursuant to Article 4' on the market.
